item.title: The Philippines: Transforming Local Services for a Smart Nation
item.description: Naval launches the Naval Connect App, a fully citizen-focused digital platform that efficiently streamlines government services and positions the town at the forefront of smart, technology-driven local governance.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST to Lead Advanced Lunar Robotics Project
item.description: HKUST will lead the development of an AI-enabled dual-arm lunar robot to support Chang’E-8, advance autonomous surface exploration capabilities safely and enable future international lunar research initiatives.

item.title: Vietnam: Strategic Digital Breakthroughs to Drive Growth
item.description: Vietnam is accelerating science, innovation and digital transformation reforms to strengthen governance, boost productivity and unlock growth through integrated institutional, infrastructure and skills development.

item.title: Singapore: NUS Boosts Smart Energy with Tandem Solar Cells
item.description: NUS has developed durable, high-efficiency perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells, enabling scalable manufacturing and seamless integration with smart grids, IoT and advanced digital energy systems.

item.title: Australia Rises to Top 5 Globally in Digital Government
item.description: Australia emerges as a global leader in digital government, achieving 98.5% in the World Bank’s 2025 GovTech Index, ranking among the top five worldwide and demonstrating innovation, efficiency and services.

item.title: India’s Strategic Path to Responsible, Ethical AI Leadership
item.description: India is emerging as a global AI leader, combining rapid talent development, innovation and responsible governance to drive economic growth while ensuring ethical and inclusive technology adoption.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU’s Human-Robot System for Smart Manufacturing
item.description: PolyU has developed an advanced human-robot collaboration system that enables flexible, intelligent, autonomous and high-precision manufacturing for complex Industry 5.0 tasks across industrial sectors.

item.title: Vietnam: Technology, Skills and Innovation to Boost Industrial Growth
item.description: Prime Minister Chinh emphasises that technology, digitalisation, innovation, and workforce skills are central to Vietnam’s industrial growth and economic development goals for 2026.

item.title: Malaysia: MPI Backs Smart Transformation of Media Industry
item.description: Malaysia’s Media Innovation Fund, backed by MPI, aims to drive smart, technology-driven transformation, enhance digital skills and strengthen capabilities in the country’s media industry.

item.title: Indonesia: BSSN, Planning Ministry to Boost National Cyber Resilience
item.description: Indonesia’s BSSN and the Ministry of National Development Planning have signed a 5-year agreement to enhance cybersecurity and support the nation’s digital transformation and resilience.
